name: ActivitySignupBoard
tagline: Club and CCA sign-up with capacity, eligibility, clash checks and waitlists — for school portals.
description: A phone-friendly extracurricular sign-up board for Power Pages, Model-driven and Canvas apps: activity cards with live capacity, grade eligibility, per-category limits, timetable-clash detection, waitlists or ranked preferences, a weekly timetable, fees and parent consent, saved as JSON in one column.
features: Activity cards with capacity bars, waitlist positions and status badges
Grade eligibility, per-category limits and choice limit with clear reasons
Timetable clash detection against other choices and fixed commitments
Weekly timetable grid and phone day list
My choices with reorder, consent, validation and submit receipt
Search, day filter, category chips, sorting
16 outputs and a DOM change event for Power Pages
